{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the columns
print(df.columns.tolist())

# Create the treatment response variable: change in biomarker
# Δbiomarker = biomarker_final - biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Define population: all patients with valid sex and biomarker_change
# (i.e., no missing sex or either biomarker)
population = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'biomarker_change'])

# Compute mean change by sex
mean_change_by_sex = population.groupby('sex')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute difference in mean change: female - male
mean_diff = mean_change_by_sex['F'] - mean_change_by_sex['M']

# Print results
print("Mean change in biomarker by sex:")
print(mean_change_by_sex)
print(f"\nDifference (F - M): {mean_diff}")

# Check group sizes to ensure comparability
print(f"\nGroup sizes:\n{population['sex'].value_counts()}")"}
